# Installed host foundation consumers

## Purpose

Maintainer-owned regression evidence for agency through the ordinary installed
application client and portable FLOW artifact APIs. These consumers are authored
with platform context. They are not unfamiliar-consumer usability qualification.

## Ownership

- `materialize.ts` constructs two independent temporary consumer repositories and
  installs exact frozen Jig/FLOW archives using the installed-test conventions.
- `adaptive/` owns deterministic candidate production, reviewed evaluation,
  independent acceptance, and explicit final artifact selection.
- `documents/` owns a separate noncoding producer/validator application.
- `recipe/` owns the exact TypeScript 5.7.3 and Zod 3.23.8 development closure.
  Its generated Bun lock is retained verbatim as `bun.lock.txt` and copied to the
  ordinary `bun.lock` filename when constructing a consumer.
- `../../host/installed-host-foundation.test.ts` owns native
  registration. Fixture modules register no tests and acquire no owners on import.

## Local Contracts

- Consumer methods import only public `@jigging/flow`. Application drivers import
  only public `@jigging/jig/client` plus ordinary platform libraries. Inert project
  declarations use the ordinary public Jig authoring entrypoint.
- Each separate application installs frozen archives normally. Its nested Jig
  project consumes the byte-identical SDK archive as a declared source workspace
  member. This qualifies source-workspace consumption of a frozen public artifact,
  not registry publication or standalone packaged-dependency consumption.
- No private helpers, custom launchers, provider calls, source admission changes,
  runtime installation, or checkpoint assumptions enter either application.
- Native opt-in and actual native prerequisite observation precede payloads.
  Missing prerequisites fail the whole selected host file. There are no skips.
- Preserve failed consumers, exact archive digests, and bounded private command
  transcripts. Delete successful temporary roots only after terminal cleanup and
  exported-byte assertions. Command exit alone is not cleanup evidence.
- Candidate tests are process evidence, not independent acceptance. Deterministic
  iteration proves artifact/evaluation composition, not adaptation quality.
- Cancellation and client-death cases await a real reviewed HTTP request.
  They then stop the original attempt and require settlement without replay.
  Request counts, protected owner rows and native residue provide independent
  observations. Prior completed results remain immutable.
- Before/after native residue compares this sequential profile's delegated
  `jig-run-` cgroups or `org.jig.native.` launchd jobs. Run no concurrent native
  owners in that same qualification namespace while measuring this inventory.

## Work Guidance

- Keep each application independent of the repository layout.
- Parent automation owns suite registration and frozen-profile reruns.

## Verification

- `bun packages/jig/test/fixtures/host-foundation/validate.ts` checks construction
  and bundles every owned consumer source without executing it.
- `bun test packages/jig/test/host/installed-host-foundation.test.ts` requires the
  exact qualified native profile and frozen archives (or already built packable
  candidates). Source validation does not substitute for this installed gate.
